name: Google Business Profile

reach.source: Google Business Profile; no Nigerian reach figure published
reach.note: Reaches Search and Maps at the moment someone looks for the business. No ad spend.

economics.benchmark: No media cost. Posts, offers, photos, hours and review replies are free.

api.quota: Project quota granted after access approval; 429 when exceeded

automation.why: The Business Profile API is the sanctioned path. The web UI is not licensed for automated posting.

playbook: Claim the profile, add hours, photos and a first Offer post. For Nigerian SMEs this is the highest-return zero-naira channel and the least contested.

name: Google Merchant Center

reach.source: Google Merchant Center; Nigeria appears on third-party supported-country lists
reach.note: Free product listings across Search, Maps and YouTube; confirm Nigerian eligibility in a live Merchant Center account before promising it.

economics.benchmark: No media cost for free listings. Shopping ads are optional and auction-priced.

api.quota: Merchant API per-method quotas; feed size limits apply

automation.why: Merchant API is the sanctioned read/write surface; UI automation is not permitted.

playbook: One feed is the whole integration. Push product title, price, availability, image and GTIN; fix disapprovals before spending on Shopping ads.

name: Meta Ads (Facebook)

reach.source: DataReportal Digital 2026 Nigeria / Meta ad tools
reach.note: Facebook ad reach. Instagram adds 10.0M, but the audiences overlap and must not be summed.

economics.entry: No minimum; NGN card or prepaid
economics.benchmark: Nigeria CPM ≈ $1.50 (≈₦1,995); CPC ≈ $0.12 (≈₦160) — 2026 country benchmarks

api.quota: Limited tier 60 points / 300s; Full tier 9,000 points

automation.why: Meta Platform Terms bar automated access without written permission. OAuth plus app review is the only sanctioned route.

playbook: Start on Limited access for one ad account. Full Access needs 500+ calls in 15 days, error rate under 15%, app review and business verification.

name: Instagram Ads

reach.source: DataReportal Digital 2026 Nigeria / Meta ad tools
reach.note: Ad reach only; overlaps heavily with Facebook.

economics.entry: No minimum; same Meta ad account
economics.benchmark: Same auction as Meta; Reels placements usually cheaper than Feed in Nigeria

api.quota: Same Marketing API tiers as Meta

automation.why: Runs through the Meta Marketing API; no separate browser automation route.

playbook: Treat as a placement, not a channel: one Meta connector, Reels-first creative, separate reporting dimension.

name: Google Ads

reach.source: Semrush Trending Websites Nigeria, September 2026
reach.note: google.com visits in Nigeria — a demand signal, not the ads audience.

economics.benchmark: Auction-priced. Search CPC is usually higher than Meta's ₦160; start with exact-match local intent.

api.quota: Explorer 2,880 ops/day on production; Basic 15,000; Standard unlimited

automation.why: Google Ads API Terms require API use for programmatic management; browser automation of the UI is not sanctioned.

playbook: Developer tokens sunset on 9 September 2026. Enable the API in a Google Cloud project, then apply for Explorer — auto-approved in most cases and enough for SME campaign creation.

name: YouTube Ads

reach.source: DataReportal Digital 2026 Nigeria / Google ad tools
reach.note: YouTube ad reach in Nigeria.

economics.benchmark: Auction; view-based. Cheapest for reach with 6-second bumpers, expensive for conversions.

api.quota: Same Google Ads API access levels

automation.why: Runs through the Google Ads API; no browser route.

playbook: Bundle with Google Ads. Nigerian mobile data costs make 6s bumpers and 15s skippables the practical formats.

name: TikTok Ads

reach.source: DataReportal Digital 2026 Nigeria / TikTok ad tools
reach.note: 18+ ad reach. It equals the total Nigerian social-media identity figure, so treat it as a ceiling rather than a forecast.

economics.benchmark: Auction; usually below Meta CPM in Nigeria, but creative production is the real cost

api.quota: Per-app quotas; campaign endpoints are rate-limited

automation.why: TikTok's terms bar bots, scraping and automated interaction without written approval. API for Business is the sanctioned path.

playbook: Business verification first (certificate plus legal rep ID), then industry review. Organic-first: post 3–5 videos a week, amplify winners with Spark Ads.

name: Snapchat Ads

reach.source: DataReportal Digital 2026 Nigeria / Snap ad tools
reach.note: Ad reach; skews young and camera-first. Verify engagement before budgeting.

economics.benchmark: Auction; cheap reach, weaker lower-funnel intent in Nigeria

api.quota: Per-app; refresh-token rotation required

automation.why: The Marketing API is explicitly open to all developers; UI automation is not needed and not sanctioned.

playbook: The easiest major write integration in 2026: business account, OAuth app, scopes, no general app-review gate documented. Add it after Meta for a second social write path.

name: WhatsApp Business

reach.source: Statista / Krestel Digital 2026 Nigeria report (self-declared use, 16+)
reach.note: Highest-reach platform in Nigeria, but it is a messaging channel, not a discovery surface.

economics.entry: 1,000 free service messages per business number per month
economics.benchmark: Marketing template $0.0516 ≈ ₦69; utility/service $0.0067 ≈ ₦9 per delivered message (1 Oct 2026 rates)

api.quota: Messaging limits per number; template approval required

automation.why: Cloud API only. Automating WhatsApp Web or the consumer app violates the terms and risks the number.

playbook: Use Click-to-WhatsApp ads and the free 72-hour entry window. Keep marketing templates rare; utility messages (order, delivery, COD) are ~₦9 and far more welcome.

name: Jiji

reach.source: Semrush jiji.ng traffic, September 2026
reach.note: Global visits; 2.47M from Nigeria. 3.36 pages/visit, 9m29s average session.

economics.entry: Free listings; Boost packages; Pro Sales needs ₦2,500 minimum balance
economics.benchmark: Fixed package pricing, not auction. Cheapest paid visibility for physical goods in Nigeria.

api.quota: No public API

automation.why: Jiji Terms 7.14 prohibit software that interferes with normal operation; no developer API exists.

playbook: Assisted posting: generate title, description, price and photos, open the Jiji sell form prefilled where possible, human presses publish. Paid Boost/Pro Sales from the same screen.

name: Nairaland Ads

reach.source: Semrush nairaland.com traffic, September 2026
reach.note: Global visits; 2.65M from Nigeria. 4.59 pages/visit, 10m38s average session, 38.6% bounce.

economics.entry: ₦5,000 minimum ad credit; 318×106 banner; six slots per section
economics.benchmark: Sep 2026: Health ₦9,927/mo, Fashion ₦3,219/mo, Adverts ₦34,662/mo, Business ₦333,908/mo, Top Pages ₦878,687/mo

api.quota: No public API; /campaign is a web console

automation.why: No API, and the forum runs an aggressive anti-spam bot that bans accounts for automated ad posting.

playbook: Buy section banners, not forum posts. At ₦9,927/month, a Health placement beats Meta's ≈₦1,995 CPM only above ~5,000 monthly impressions — measure before renewing.

name: Opera Ads

reach.source: Statcounter Nigeria browser market share, September 2026
reach.note: Opera is the #2 browser in Nigeria after Chrome (69.1%); Opera News adds in-app inventory.

economics.entry: Self-serve; minimum budget was $100 (≈₦133,000) at launch — confirm current
economics.benchmark: CPC or CPM; strong mobile reach, weaker targeting than Meta

api.quota: Report API token issued by Opera

automation.why: Only reporting and server-to-server conversion APIs are documented. Campaign creation stays in the console.

playbook: Integrate reporting first. For writes, use assisted launch: prepare the campaign in GrowthAds, then open Opera Ad Manager with the plan beside it.

name: Facebook Marketplace & buy/sell groups

reach.source: Facebook Marketplace 10-year Nigeria release, October 2026
reach.note: New listings per month in Nigeria; electronics alone exceeds 180,000/month.

economics.benchmark: No media cost. Paid boosts optional but not required.

api.quota: No Marketplace listing API for third parties

automation.why: No listing API. Meta's terms prohibit automated access; group rules also ban spam.

playbook: Generate a listing kit (title, price, 5 photos, first message) and a deep link. The owner posts to Marketplace and 3–5 local groups; no bot.

name: Microsoft Advertising

reach.source: Microsoft Advertising; no Nigerian reach figure published
reach.note: Small in Nigeria but cheap search inventory and a real write API.

economics.benchmark: Low competition; useful only where Bing/Copilot search intent exists

api.quota: Developer token; third-party approval up to 5 business days

automation.why: The Advertising API is the sanctioned surface; UI automation is not.

playbook: Defer until Google Ads is live. Reuse the same search campaign draft with a different adapter.

name: X Ads

reach.source: DataReportal Digital 2026 Nigeria / X ad tools
reach.note: Ad reach; male-skewed and concentrated in Lagos/Abuja professional audiences.

economics.entry: Ads account; API is separately pay-per-use
economics.benchmark: X API (organic posting) is $0.015/post from 20 April 2026; the Ads API is separately restricted

api.quota: Pay-per-usage credits; legacy $200 Basic only for existing subscribers

automation.why: X terms and developer agreement bar scraping and automated interaction outside the API.

playbook: Not a free channel in 2026. Use organic posts plus a deep link; only add the paid API when a client's audience justifies it.

name: LinkedIn Ads

reach.source: DataReportal Digital 2026 Nigeria / LinkedIn ad tools
reach.note: Registered members, not monthly active users.

economics.benchmark: Most expensive per click of the majors; use for B2B lead gen only

api.quota: Marketing API partner agreement required

automation.why: User Agreement bars bots and scraping; Marketing API access is partner-gated.

playbook: Do not build in wave 1. Offer assisted campaign setup and reporting exports until partner approval is realistic.

name: Pinterest Ads

reach.source: Pinterest; no Nigerian reach figure published in the 2026 report
reach.note: Low Nigerian relevance; useful for fashion, decor and food discovery.

economics.benchmark: Auction; cheap awareness, weak local intent

api.quota: Per-app; standard v5 quotas

automation.why: Pinterest API terms prohibit automated access outside the API.

playbook: Defer. If a fashion client asks, publish organic Pins from a content calendar and skip the ads integration.

name: Reddit Ads

reach.source: DataReportal Digital 2026 Nigeria / Reddit ad tools
reach.note: Very small Nigerian audience.

economics.benchmark: Cheap global inventory, negligible Nigerian scale

api.quota: Ads API access request

automation.why: Reddit's terms prohibit automated access outside approved API use.

playbook: Skip for Nigeria. Revisit only for diaspora or developer-tool campaigns.

name: Adsterra

reach.source: Adsterra; global network, no Nigerian reach figure published
reach.note: Popunder/native inventory; Nigerian traffic is available but quality varies.

economics.entry: Minimum deposit varies by payment method
economics.benchmark: CPM/CPA; cheap volume, weak brand safety

api.quota: Ads API v3; account token

automation.why: Documented REST API for campaign creation; no need for browser automation.

playbook: Use only for app-install or sweepstake-style offers. Keep it out of the default SME plan; brand safety is poor.

name: PropellerAds

reach.source: PropellerAds; global network
reach.note: Push/pop/interstitial inventory; API open to all advertisers.

economics.benchmark: Cheap CPM; low intent

api.quota: REST API; account token

automation.why: API is open to all advertisers.

playbook: Same role as Adsterra. One adapter can cover both if the payloads are normalised.

name: MGID

reach.source: MGID; global native network
reach.note: Native content placements; low Nigerian brand demand.

economics.benchmark: CPC/CPM; native CTR depends entirely on creative

api.quota: REST API for advertisers

automation.why: Documented add/modify API.

playbook: Defer until there is a content-led client. Native ads need editorial creative, which is a different production workflow.

name: Jumia

reach.source: Semrush, cited in Jiji competitor panel, September 2026
reach.note: Marketplace visits; seller centre, not an ad-buying API.

economics.entry: Seller account; commissions and fulfilment fees
economics.benchmark: Retail media and sponsored products are sales-led

api.quota: Seller portal; no self-serve ads API documented

automation.why: Seller portal only; no public campaign API.

playbook: Partner conversation, not an integration. Offer catalogue export and let the seller team upload.

name: Konga

reach.source: Semrush, cited in Jiji competitor panel, September 2026
reach.note: Marketplace visits; seller portal.

economics.benchmark: Sponsored placements are sales-led

api.quota: Seller portal; no public ads API

automation.why: No public campaign API.

playbook: Defer. Lower traffic than Jumia and the same sales-led shape.

name: Transsion Ads (TECNO / Infinix / itel)

reach.source: Transsion Ads; vendor claims 300M+ unique devices per day globally
reach.note: Device-level inventory across Palmstore, HiOS, XOS and itelOS. No Nigerian breakdown published.

economics.benchmark: Direct-sold CPM/CPA; likely a high minimum

api.quota: No documented self-serve API

automation.why: No self-serve surface to automate.

playbook: Best reached through a media agency. Keep as a partnership option for brand campaigns, not an SME self-serve channel.

name: Terragon

reach.source: Terragon; no public reach figure
reach.note: Nigerian ad-tech and data company; campaigns are sales-led.

economics.benchmark: Quoted per campaign

api.quota: No documented self-serve API

automation.why: No self-serve surface.

playbook: Agency partnership only. Do not put it on the product roadmap.
